items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Terminology 5:1
items.html: From the second restriction onward, the name of HB changed to AVI. The reason is as it is written in the Zohar, that Aba put Ima outside on account of her son. For through the second restriction, Bina went outside all the degrees: the Bina of the Rosh went out to the Guf [body], to HGT; the Bina of the Guf went out to NHY; and the Bina of NHY went out to BYA, as is known. Thus it is regarded that the Hochma of all the degrees put the Bina of all the degrees outside. And through this exit of hers, room was made in her to bestow Mochin upon the sons and to correct them — that is, had Bina not gone outside, there would have been no possibility whatsoever for ZON to be corrected. Therefore the Bina that went outside received the name Ima, to indicate that she descended from her degree in order to beget sons, and to raise them and complete them; and they are ZON. And you should understand that the beginning of her descent for the sake of ZON was the secret of the expansion of SAG of AK below the Tabur of AK, as written in Part 6; for there are the discernments of the roots of ZON of AK, and Bina, who is SAG, descended in order to correct them. And there she received into herself the discernment of Malchut, and therefore she went out of all the degrees. Her second descent was in the Katnut of Nekudim, after which, through her return to the degree — that is, in the Gadlut of Nekudim — she corrected the Mochin of the ZAT of Nekudim, which are ZON. And her third descent was in Atzilut, after which, through her return to the degree, she bestows upon all the NRNHY of ZON, as written (in Inner Light, p. 626, Sub Header, “And Arich,” see the whole continuation there). Thus the whole of Bina’s descent is the faithful cause of the completion of the sons, and therefore this Bina is called the mother of the sons. See also Inner Light, p. 658, Sub Header, “And with this you will understand,” the whole continuation to its end. (p. 599, Item 2)
